title: Telemetry services stops working each time I upgrade to the next version of code and require deploy minigraph
author: gechiang
body:
---------------------------------------------------
BUG REPORT INFORMATION
---------------------------------------------------
**Description**
Branch: Mater branch.  any recent image (SONiC.master.491-af654944 as an example) all exhibit this issue.

Each time I upgrade from the same branch Telemetry certificate is lost and require to deploy minigraph to bring back the service.
Wondering why this is the behavior?  Can this be automatically carried over as part of the image upgrade and spare the user to have to keep fixing this each time an image upgrade took place?  This will certainly enhance user experience.

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**
1.  Upgrade to another master image
2.  wait for the DUT to boot up and perform show services and telemetry will not be there.

If we are upgrading to a different branch such as from 20191130 to master, then there may be difficulties where it is not possible to keep the certificate needed for telemetry and re-deploy minigraph as a solution is acceptable. comments.author: lguohan
comments.body: we are not doing deploy minigraph for fast reboot and warm reboot, so it mean the telemetry feature is broken for warm reboot and fast reboot. need to be addressed.

comments.author: pra-moh
comments.body:
> we are not doing deploy minigraph for fast reboot and warm reboot, so it mean the telemetry feature is broken for warm reboot and fast reboot. need to be addressed.

It is happening in buildimage because deploy-mg(config_sonic_basedon_testbed.yml) creates and deploy certs.  I think I need to find out way to preserve certs using ansible.
For Production it will be always hardware proxy who will be pushing certs. Not sure how fast/warm reboot can break this?

comments.author: lguohan
comments.body:
> For Production it will be always hardware proxy who will be pushing cert

Have you confirmed that?

comments.author: lguohan
comments.body: on the other side, I agree with @gechiang , it is just poor engineering practice that we cannot handle this for normal sonic upgrade scenario.

comments.author: pra-moh
comments.body:
> on the other side, I agree with @gechiang , it is just poor engineering practice that we cannot handle this for normal sonic upgrade scenario.

Agree! I We can follow similar practice of other certs in sonic.

linkedPullRequests.title: Telemetry Certificate Copy Across Image Upgrade.
linkedPullRequests.author: abdosi
linkedPullRequests.body:
Why/What I did:
To copy telemetry certificate during image upgrade from previous image to new image
Closing Issue https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/issues/5955.

How I did:

Added "telemetry directory" to the list of files/directory that gest copied when new images booted.


How I verify:

- Verified Telemetry Certificate are restored from 201811 to 201911
- Verified Telemetry Certificate are restored from 201911 to 201911
